title: Zanzibar Spiced Plantain
community: Zanzibar — the spiced plantain breakfast or dessert
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Zanzibar Spiced Plantain — ripe plantains pan-fried in coconut oil with cardamom, cinnamon, and honey until caramelised and golden. The sweetest Zanzibar breakfast — simple, fragrant, and deeply satisfying.
longDesc: Spiced fried plantain is the sweet breakfast of Zanzibar — when the plantains are fully ripe (almost black skin), pan-fried with Zanzibar cardamom and cinnamon, and drizzled with honey, they become something extraordinary.
ingredients: 3 very ripe plantains — peeled and sliced diagonally
steps: Heat coconut oil over medium heat.
Add plantain slices in a single layer.
Flip. Sprinkle cardamom and cinnamon over.
Drizzle honey over in the last 30 seconds.
chefTips: Very ripe plantains — almost black skin. They caramelise far better.
The honey goes on at the very end — it burns if added too early.
cookingScience: Very ripe plantains have converted most of their starch to natural sugars (glucose and fructose). These sugars caramelise rapidly in the pan, producing the characteristic golden-brown exterior and deep sweetness that starchy under-ripe plantains cannot achieve.
sustainabilityTips: Zanzibar and coastal Tanzania produce excellent plantains.
culturalNote: Spiced fried plantain is the gentlest Zanzibar breakfast — the sweet counterpoint to the strong spiced coffee, eaten quietly as the island wakes.
